# ariadne: assembling relational information across the database network ![](reference/figures/ariadne_logo.png)

[![issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/Minotau-R/ariadne)](https://github.com/Minotau-R/ariadne/issues)
[![pulls](https://img.shields.io/github/issues-pr/Minotau-R/ariadne)](https://github.com/Minotau-R/ariadne/pulls)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Minotau-R/ariadne/workflows/build/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Minotau-R/ariadne/actions)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/Minotau-R/ariadne/graph/badge.svg?token=8P7EK6T6WX)](https://codecov.io/gh/Minotau-R/ariadne)
[![CodeFactor](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/minotau-r/ariadne/badge)](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/minotau-r/ariadne)

ariadne is a multi-purpose R package that integrates relational
knowledge from various biological databases. It provides tools to
navigate the resource graph, find and visualise paths between features
and link them across different omics by leveraging the resource graph
hosted in the companion package
[ariadneDB](https://github.com/Minotau-R/ariadneDB). It is also
available in Python with the package
[ariadnePy](https://github.com/Minotau-R/ariadnePy/tree/main) and as a
web app with the Shiny package
[ariadneApp](https://github.com/Minotau-R/ariadneApp).

Example applications:

- Link across omics types based on prior knowledge (KEGG, UniProt, Rhea,
  etc.)
- Stratify microbial features by functional modules (BugSig, Gut
  Modules, etc.)
- Translate across different taxonomies (NCBI, SILVA, OTT, etc.)

## Installation instructions

The release version can be installed from Bioconductor with:

    if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
        install.packages("BiocManager")

    BiocManager::install("ariadne")

To access the latest functionality, the development version can be
installed with:

    if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
        install.packages("BiocManager")

    # Initialize Bioconductor devel version
    BiocManager::install(version = "devel")

    BiocManager::install("ariadne")

## Educational resources

To learn more about ariadne in theory and practice, it is recommended to
consult the following material:

- [(Poster) ariadne: enriching your ’omics analyses with prior knowledge
  from public databases](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20411835)
- [(Talk) Ariadne’s thread: Navigating the maze of Biology (without
  getting lost)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20596249)

## Terms of Use

While ariadne itself is openly available under an Artistic 2.0 license,
the resources included in the ariadne database come with their
respective licenses that must be carefully observed. Find more about the
resources accessible via ariadne in [this
vignette](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadneDB/articles/ariadneDB.html).

## Code of Conduct

Please note that the ariadne project is released with a [Contributor
Code of Conduct](https://bioconductor.org/about/code-of-conduct/). By
contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms.
Contributions are welcome in the form of feedback, issues and pull
requests. You can find our contributor guidelines
[here](https://github.com/microbiome/mia/blob/devel/CONTRIBUTING.md).

# Package index

## Work with the resource graph

- [`ariadne()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/ariadne.md)
  : Build ariadne resource graph
- [`addResource()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/addResource.md)
  : Add resources to graph
- [`searchPath()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/searchPath.md)
  : Search paths between resources
- [`plotPath()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/plotPath.md)
  : Plot paths between resources
- [`weavePath()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/weavePath.md)
  [`weaveComplex()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/weavePath.md)
  : Weave paths between resources

## Access resource graph metadata

- [`linkNames()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/linkNames.md)
  : Link ids to names and vice versa
- [`drawPath()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/drawPath.md)
  : Draw path steps as a reproducible table
- [`listResourceCatalogue()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/listResourceCatalogue.md)
  : Consult catalogue of resources registered in the ariadne database
- [`listResourceVersions()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/listResourceVersions.md)
  : List resource versions registered in the ariadne database

## Work with output sets

- [`getSets()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/addSets.md)
  [`addSets()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/addSets.md)
  : Append linkmaps to SummarizedExperiment side information
- [`plotSets()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/plotSets.md)
  : Visualise sets network
- [`processGeneFamilies()`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/processGeneFamilies.md)
  : Process HUMAnN gene families

## Import package datasets

- [`butyrate`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/butyrate.md)
  : Dataset of butyrate producers
- [`pathMeta`](https://minotau-r.github.io/ariadne/reference/pathMeta.md)
  : Data frame for pathway from chebi to gmm
